text.p: The following are the leading stories in the Maltese press on Wednesday. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.
- Government White Paper proposes setting up of army reserve corps based on volunteers and retired soldiers.

- Industry Minister John Attard Montalto says government will issue a list of raw materials which will be exempt from the new excise tax on imports when it is introduced on July 1 to replace VAT. The exemptions will benefit industry.
- Court jails three people and fines seven over violent incidents 10 years ago during 1987 general elections.
